messages.author: 6db62e08ec862130
messages.subject: Eigen::MatrixBase?
parts:
I realize that this is probably only of interest to non-stan code, but
would the stan team accept patches changing function arguments from
Eigen::Matrix to Eigen::MatrixBase?

For OpenMx, this would allow us to use Eigen::Map<> on memory directly
instead of copying it to Eigen::Matrix objects.

--

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Eigen::MatrixBase?
parts:
[cc-ing stan-dev]

Absolutely. It's been something we've been meaning to
do ourselves and haven't done. When we first wrote it we
didn't understand the expression templates well enough to understand
the discussion here:

http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/TopicFunctionTakingEigenTypes.html

The new autodiff we're writing is being better behaved from the get-go.

- Bob

P.S. Could we continue this discussion on stan-dev? I try to keep
these discussions that don't impact our user interfaces off of
stan-users. I can give you (Joshua) permission to post on stan-dev.
